exposure: timing of blood glucose measurement after birth
cohort: The study included 3,912 healthy newborns admitted to the well-baby nursery at Shaare Zedek Medical Center, with a mean birth weight of 3,322 g and mean gestational age of 39.4 weeks.
finding: The normal range of point-of-care blood glucose levels in healthy neonates within 180 minutes after birth had a median concentration of 58 mg/dL (IQR, 51-67 mg/dL), with extreme low levels (1st, 3rd, and 5th percentiles at 34, 39, and 41 mg/dL respectively) being rare.
cross-section timing: Within 180 minutes after birth (median age 73 minutes, IQR 55-92 minutes)
